SANSKRIT GRAMMAR. [§ 340

'one who lives upon wages'.-(19) to words denoting 
musical instruments in the sense of 'playing upon'; &c. 
वृर्दङ्गवादनं शिल्पमस्य मार्दङ्गिकः 'one whose profession 
is to play on a tabor'; so वैणिकः fr. Vinā; similarly 
वैणविकः; मादुकः or मादुकिकः; झाल्लरिकः, &c.-(20) to 
पद् and the remaining words* of that group in the 
sense of 'walking with the assistance of;' पादिकः [पदेन 
चरति इति, येन पदेन पद्भ्यमचरन्ति स पदः Sid. Kan.]; अन्धेन 
चरति आन्धिकः, रथिकः &c. पथा चरति पथिकः 'a traveller'; 
this is also added to words denoting inanimate things. 
वारिपथिकं दारु 'wood carried on by the force of water'; 
(21) to words included in the भस्त्रादि † group in the 
sense of 'bears or carries by means of' भस्त्रया हरतीति 
भस्त्रिकः; and to the word वि-शीवध; वि-शीवधेन हरति वि-शीव-
धिकः; also वैशधिकः:-(22) to कुसीद and दशैकादशन् in 
the sense of 'lending on interest' कुसीदिकः 'a usurer', 
दशैकादशिकः 'one who lends another ten rupees in 
order to get back eleven i. e. 'a usurer'; and (23) to 
आकर्ष; आकर्षेण चरति आकर्षिकः 'magnetic, attractive'.

) Added to पूर्व or words ending in पूर्व and to श्राद्ध it has 
the sense of 'done and eaten by' respectively; कृतपूर्वी कर्ता; 
श्राद्धमनेन भुक्तं श्राद्धी 'one who has eaten at a Śrāddha'; 
(2) it is added to a few words, such as खल, कुद्रव, 
&c. in the sense of 'a collection of' with fem. term. 
ई added to it; खलानां समूहः खलिनी 'a multitude of 
threshing floors or wicked men', कुद्रविनी 'a number

* These are अन्ध, अश्मन्, रथ, जाल, व्याल, and बाधु.
† भस्त्र, घट, भरम, शीर्ष-भे-भार, अंस-भे-भार, &c.
